command: set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; PKG=io.blueeye; OLD='/tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-old.apk'; DATA='/tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-data.tar'; rm -f "$OLD" "$DATA"; P=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -n1); adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$P" "$OLD" >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as "$PKG" sh -c 'cd /data/user/0/io.blueeye && tar cf - databases files shared_prefs' > "$DATA"; echo old_apk_sha=$(shasum -a 256 "$OLD" | awk '{print $1}'); echo data_tar_sha=$(shasum -a 256 "$DATA" | awk '{print $1}'); test "$(shasum -a 256 "$OLD" | awk '{print $1}')" = 'acd11814ebbd3a2d5a3a8cdc1c51e1338d98d7e447ebc1421603f230697f116c'; tar tf "$DATA" | head -n 80; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; tar xf "$DATA" -C "$T"; sqlite3 "$T/databases/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) from devices; select count(*) from signal_samples; select count(*) from follow_me_observations;'; echo PRIVATE_BACKUP_PASS
